summary: Master land law and property rights. Learn land tenure, cadastral systems, and acquisition strategies to secure assets and ensure compliance. Enroll today.
lede: Property law examines how land rights are owned, recorded, transferred and managed. For professionals who manage, advise on or administer land-based assets, this course develops skills in assessing tenure risks, interpreting cadastral information and planning land acquisition or resettlement. Learners also explore property valuation, land-use planning and ways to resolve land disputes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, regulate, or advise on land-based assets and property rights within corporate, governmental, or international organizations.
modules: Land Tenure Systems and Legal Frameworks
Land Use Planning and Zoning Regulations
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of real estate or legal principles. Access to a laptop for cadastral mapping exercises and valuation modeling is required. Familiarity with basic land administration terminology is recommended for the advanced modules.
